answer: Proposal: proof-of-unique-replication admission. Each identity must keep online a full replica of a shared dataset, encrypted with an identity-keyed cipher, and answer random space-time audits each epoch. Clones such as sparrow and dune cannot timeshare one disk: both face challenges demanding full distinct replicas, so storage spend, not headcount, bounds reward. Assumes honest audit randomness and per-identity reward capped near rental cost; limit: wealth buys disks linearly and colluding auditors weaken the check.
